newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S KAIRINOS SHARE OFFER OVER-SUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S KAIRINOS SHARE OFFER OVER-SUBSCRIBED.

text.p: South Africa's Kairinos Foods said on Monday applications for its ordinary shares to be listed on the Johannesburg stock Exhange (JSE) exceeded the minimum subscription of 110 million rand.

The firm has rescheduled its listing to July 22 after an objection was lodged with the JSE over the usage of the abbreviation K-Foods. In resolving the issue the exchange had decided to extend both the offer period and the listing date.
The offer period was extended to July 15.
The listing will give the firm a market capitalisation of more than 250 million rand at a profit to earnings ratio of less than 10.
The group has more than 180 outlets in South Africa and will be listed on the JSE's Beverages, Hotels and Leisure sector.
The offer is in the form of 20 million shares to the public, a private placing of 98 million shares and a preferential offer of 30 million shares to directors and employers.
